in_marathi.name: Arunava
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Dawn
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arunava हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arunava is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Aruna’, which means 'dawn' or 'red'. In Hindu mythology, Arunava is the name of the god of dawn and the charioteer of the sun god Surya. The name is believed to symbolize the beginning of a new day and the promise of a fresh start.
